correctness.rationale: For each e_i, replacing one of three disjoint recovery sets by singleton systematic coordinate i reduces 3-PIR to two disjoint nonempty parity-subset sums whose systematic companions are disjoint outside i. Independently enumerated all 16^4 ordered parity tuples by parity masks: exactly 7800 qualify. Independently canonicalized S4xS4 orbits: 26; multiset sizes 72 x1,96 x4,144 x3,288 x12,576 x6, sum 7800. Independent incidence test gives 456, parity ranks 3:3000 and 4:4800, all minimum distances exactly 3. For each of 26 orbit representatives, exhaustively tested all 20 three-request multisets using inclusion-minimal recovery subsets; permutation invariance proves 3-batch for all 7800. This exhaustive proof is only for the finite 65536 systematic presentation space, not general codes.
residual_risks: The underlying optimal length 8 is explicitly known; exhaustive tests here are finite and complete, not a claim about infinite parameter families.
